title: dressupframe
summary: MSUI now has a real isolated dressing room rather than a shell-only window. DressUpFrameUiLaw owns the reference 384x512 shell, portrait, four race-backdrop quadrants, 316x351 model pane, rotation controls, Reset/Close buttons, slot mapping, held-lane eviction, ranged-hand split, and Gnome/Troll backdrop substitutions. A dedicated CharacterRenderer and 632x702 transparent render target clone the current player's body and visible melee look without mutating live equipment; resolved try-ons replace only their visual slot, linked items wait for the item-template cache, Reset reclones the player look, and Close empties the room. Ctrl-click entry points cover chat item links, bags, the paper doll, inspect, merchant rows, quest and quest-log items, loot rows and group-loot icons. Focused and full clinical verification cover geometry, slot/lane laws, isolation, pending resolution, and the complete current item-entry surface set.

openItems.text: Reference Ctrl-click try-on arms also exist on quest/quest-log reward items, loot and group-loot rows. MSUI's principal chat, bag, paper-doll, inspect and merchant paths are wired, but those secondary item surfaces still need the same DressUpItemLink route where their current interaction models expose an item entry.
openItems.resolution: Quest/quest-log item rows now give Ctrl-click precedence over reward selection, LootFrame rows give it precedence over autostore, and GroupLootFrame icons queue the roll item. These join the existing chat, bag, paper-doll, inspect and merchant routes.

openItems.text: Live-verify representative race/gender backdrops and model crops, base gear cloning, body armor/helm/shoulder/weapon substitutions, bow versus gun hand routing, two-hand eviction, linked-item pending resolution, repeat Ctrl-click accumulation, Reset, both Close controls, tap-and-hold rotation, painterly rebake, and gameplay-scale seating.
